newsitem.title: USA: Integon blames reserves, prices for Q4 shr.
newsitem.headline: Integon blames reserves, prices for Q4 shr.

text.p: Integon Corp said Wednesday it suffered poor fourth-quarter earnings per share because it was under reserved and under priced.
The insurance company reported an operating share loss of $1.14 for the quarter ended December 31 against a profit of $0.41 for the period a year ago.

Integon specializes in the underwriting and marketing of non-standard and other specialty automobile insurance products to individuals through its wholly-owned property and casualty insurance subsidiaries.
It said it increased loss reserves by $12.5 million during the fourth quarter due to "adverse development" on liability claims, primarily for the 1996 accident year.

It also said it wrote off $3.5 million of deferred policy acquisition costs and increased the reserve for bad debt to $2.0 million before taxes "to recognize a pattern of high write offs in recent months".

"Although these adjustments were painful to make, they will lessen the possibility of 1997 being negatively impacted by business written in 1996," it said. "We dealt with the reserves and we are now dealing with the pricing."
